site.name: Dot Abyss Wiki
site.description: A fan-made wiki for Dot Abyss (ドットアビス): character data, skills, the Crest system and team building.

home.heroBody: Every character, the Crest system, Force Chain, and how to build a party of ten in Dot Abyss.
home.crestBody: Two crest types, stacking up to {max} times. A character holds only one type at a time, and buffs scale with the stack count.
home.forceChainBody: Spend a Mana Crystal to fire a skill before its gauge fills. That unlocks the additional effect of the skill, which is where crest payoffs live.
home.partyBody: Start from Front {front} / Back {back} and fill the rest with Assist units: they never enter combat but boost the party in proportion to their own Assist stats.
home.elementBody: Enemies have a weakness element and take more damage from it. Your characters have no weakness element, so enemy elements never raise incoming damage. A healer heals more when the target shares its element.

character.noDetailBody: Only roster-level data is recorded for this character. Skills and passives are being added batch by batch.
character.awakeningNote: SSR units have 2 passive slots, SR and R have 1. Awakening effects are unlocked by Limit Break with duplicates and exist only on SSR.
